如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    许清雪走在许紫烟的身后，不时地瞄上一眼许紫烟的背影。心里不停地在思索着，其实昨天一夜她就没有怎么睡好。翻来覆去地想着自己和许紫烟交手的情景，那一幕幕不停地在自己的眼前回放这也。
她自小就被家里看做一个天才少女，三岁看是修炼，十三岁便练到了后天第六层，这在许氏家族中不是没有，而且还不少。但是像她这样从来没有服食过一粒丹药，全凭着自己的努力而修炼到后天第六层的人可就非常地少了。
在许氏家族中，其实不仅仅是在许氏家族中，在这块大陆上的每一个家族中，那些嫡系弟子和普通弟子从生下来就是有区别的。虽然他们不能够像许紫烟现在把丹药当作糖豆吃，但是也有着不少的丹药可以吃，所以很多家族中的所谓天才少年就是**嗑出来的。
但是许清雪则不同，家境贫寒的她全是凭着自己的资质和努力修炼而成。所以在她小小的心里一直是非常骄傲的。昨天当许紫烟前来拜访她的时候，没有说上几句话，她就明白了许紫烟的意图。性格原本清冷骄傲的她认为是许紫烟听说了她的名声，前来向她请教。所以难免就有些倨傲。
而且她的心里深切地以为，修炼是没有什么可说的。如果想要交流，那就只有打过才能够懂得。当她刚想要和许紫烟说出来的时候，没有想到许紫烟误会她是不愿意和自己交流，便提出了告辞。
许紫烟走后，许清雪觉得自己收了对方的礼物，而且看出许紫烟明显是误会了自己，心中便有些歉意，便决定等到许紫烟回来，自己便去拜访于她，大不了自己和她切磋一下，在交手中指点对方一下。
但是交手的结果却是令她十分地尴尬和沮丧，刚开始自己还能够占点优势，可是只是十几个回合之后，自己就优势尽失。最后更是被许紫烟一拳击退，而且许清雪可以看出对方明显地没有出全力。
再一次抬头看了一眼许紫烟的背影，许清雪的心中突然闪过了一个念头，眼前的这个许紫烟绝对不是池中之物，将来说不定会一飞冲天。如果自己现在和她结交，说不定将来会对自己有着很大的帮助。可是自己就要这样臣服于她吗？骄傲的许清雪在心里又有着不愿，于是，一路恍恍惚惚地跟着许紫烟等人来到了授课大殿。
大家挑选了一个地方，席地而坐，轻声地交谈着，等待着老师的出现。过了没有一刻钟，大殿里突然静了下来，许紫烟等人也急忙闭口，抬头向着前面望去。只见一个中年男子信步走上了前面的讲台。许紫烟运灵眼一望，便看出对方是一个炼气期第一层的修为。
那个中年人走上讲台，也不看大家，直接开口便开始了授课。底下都静悄悄地，一个个认真地聆听着。今天是新进外堂的弟子的第一堂课，所以讲的是后天第五层到地十二层修炼的基础要领。而这些正是新进弟子所缺少的，所以一个个听得极其认真，如痴如醉。
此时的大殿之内，坐的都是新进弟子，也就那么几十个人。而那些外堂的老人们，知道这是新进弟子的第一堂课，讲的都是一些最基础的东西，所以他们根本就没有来。
许紫烟在底下也十分认真地听着，她的修为自然与这些新进弟子不同，而且传承中又有着一套极其完整的功法，所以授课老师的每一句话，她都会立刻领悟，并且举一反三，触类旁通，大受启发。很快许紫烟就将老师传授的东西融会贯通。
老师讲完课之后，举目扫了底下的弟子一眼，只见众弟子的目光俱都一片茫然。他在心里偷偷一笑，今天他只是给大家讲了一下后天第六层到第十二层修炼的总纲，心里知道这些初次解除这个层次的弟子们不可能听得懂，能够有一两层明白就算不错了。想当初自己第一次进入外堂听讲的时候，不也是一样的茫然吗？反正日后会给他们逐层地讲解，到那时他们是否能够理解，就要看个人的悟性了。
感慨了一下，也不想打扰这些弟子领悟，便想要离开。可是他的目光忽然一凝，他看到了坐在人群中的许紫烟。只见许紫烟坐在那里，目光一片清明，那里有一丝一毫的迷茫。
此时的许紫烟看到老师停下来，明显是要离开的样子。便想着自己等人是不是也应该离开了，可是等到她看向身边的许丽和许凌等人的时候，发现他们都呆呆地坐在那里发呆。许紫烟感觉到奇怪，便转头四顾，发现殿内的几十个人都是如此，目光中一片迷茫。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Xu Qingxue walked behind Xu Ziyan and glanced at Xu Ziyan's back from time to time. She kept thinking in her mind that she didn't sleep well last night. I kept thinking about the scene of my fight with Xu Ziyan, and the scene kept replaying in front of my eyes.
She has been regarded as a genius girl by her family since she was a child. She started practicing at the age of three and reached the sixth level of acquired skills at the age of thirteen. This is not unheard of in the Xu family, and there are quite a few. But there are very few people like her who have never taken a pill and have reached the sixth level of acquired cultivation through their own efforts.
In the Xu family, in fact, not just in the Xu family, but in every family on this continent, there is a difference between the direct disciples and the ordinary disciples from birth. Although they can't eat pills as jelly beans like Xu Ziyan now, there are still a lot of pills that can be eaten, so many so-called genius boys in the family were naughted.
But Xu Qingxue is different. She comes from a poor family and only relied on her own qualifications and hard work to achieve success. So she has always been very proud in her little heart. When Xu Ziyan came to visit her yesterday, she understood Xu Ziyan's intention without saying a few words. Originally cold and proud, she thought it was Xu Ziyan who heard about her reputation and came to ask her for advice. So it is inevitable to be a little arrogant.
And she deeply believed that there was nothing to say about cultivation. If you want to communicate, you can only understand it after playing. When she just wanted to tell Xu Ziyan, she didn't expect that Xu Ziyan misunderstood that she was unwilling to communicate with herself, so she said goodbye.
After Xu Ziyan left, Xu Qingxue felt that she had received the other party's gift, and saw that Xu Ziyan had obviously misunderstood herself, so she felt a little apologetic, and decided to wait until Xu Ziyan came back and then visit her. At worst, she could compete with her and give guidance to the other party in the fight.
However, the result of the fight made her very embarrassed and frustrated. She was able to gain some advantage at the beginning, but after only a dozen rounds, she lost all her advantage. In the end, he was knocked back by Xu Ziyan with a punch, and Xu Qingxue could see that the opponent obviously did not use his full strength.
Looking up at Xu Ziyan's back again, a thought suddenly flashed in Xu Qingxue's mind. The Xu Ziyan in front of her was definitely not a thing in the pool, and she might soar into the sky in the future. If I make friends with her now, it might be of great help to me in the future. But do I have to surrender to her like this? The proud Xu Qingxue was unwilling in her heart, so she followed Xu Ziyan and others to the teaching hall in a daze.
Everyone chose a place, sat on the ground, chatted softly, and waited for the teacher to appear. Less than a quarter of an hour later, the hall suddenly became quiet, and Xu Ziyan and others hurriedly shut up and looked up to the front. I saw a middle-aged man strolling onto the podium in front. Xu Ziyan Yunling glanced at him and saw that the other party was at the first level of Qi refining period.
The middle-aged man walked up to the podium, without looking at everyone, and started teaching directly. Everyone was quiet down there, everyone listening carefully. Today is the first class for new disciples who have entered the outer hall, so it will teach the basics of cultivation from the fifth level of the day after tomorrow to the twelfth level of the earth. These are exactly what the new disciples lack, so each one of them listened extremely seriously and mesmerized.
At this time, the people sitting in the main hall were all new disciples, only a few dozen people. As for the old people in the outer hall, they knew that this was the first class for new disciples and that it only taught the most basic things, so they didn't come at all.
Xu Ziyan was also listening very carefully below. Her cultivation was naturally incompatible with these newThe disciples are different, and the inheritance has an extremely complete set of exercises, so she will immediately understand every word of the teacher, draw inferences from one instance, draw parallels from others, and be greatly inspired. Xu Ziyan soon understood what the teacher taught him.
After the teacher finished his lecture, he raised his eyes and glanced at the disciples below, only to see that all the disciples' eyes were blank. He secretly smiled in his heart. Today he just told everyone the general outline of cultivation from the sixth to the twelfth level the day after tomorrow. He knew in his heart that these disciples who were freed from this level for the first time would not be able to understand it. It would be good if they could understand one or two levels. I remember when I first entered the outer hall to listen to the lecture, wasn't it the same feeling at a loss? Anyway, I will explain it to them layer by layer in the future. Whether they can understand it at that time depends on their personal understanding.
After sighing for a while, he didn't want to disturb these disciples' understanding, so he wanted to leave. But his eyes suddenly condensed, and he saw Xu Ziyan sitting in the crowd. I saw Xu Ziyan sitting there, his eyes clear, and there was a trace of confusion.
At this time, Xu Ziyan saw the teacher stop and obviously wanted to leave. She wondered if she and others should leave, but when she looked at Xu Li, Xu Ling and others beside her, she found that they were all sitting there in a daze. Xu Ziyan felt strange, so she turned around and found that dozens of people in the hall were like this, with confusion in their eyes.
